defect: Lossy Arabic lookup-key normalization merged supplied vocalized translation بُنّ/bunn with son entry ابن through its different-vowel alternative بْن. The wrong link also inherited the translation reading bunn.
scope: Compile-time candidate identity, not sense disambiguation or runtime grammar. Applies uniformly to Arabic marked translations/references. All unmarked competing identities and non-Arabic behavior remain.

selection_contract.lookup: Use existing normalized key only to locate candidates.
selection_contract.written_identity: For Arabic input carrying vowel/phonological marks, require exact supplied head or canonical/alternative form after NFC, case normalization and removal of nonsemantic tatweel. Never remove the supplied vowels for entry identity.
selection_contract.ambiguity: Keep every exact attested entry; no shortest synonym, gloss inference, guessed vowel or selection based on prior test appearance. Unvocalized input remains competing analyses.
selection_contract.unattested: A marked input absent from the native supplied forms has no candidate. Partially vocalized/inflected forms are not silently treated as a different canonical form.
selection_contract.readings: This patch prevents attaching the bad term/reading to the wrong entry in the observed vocalized path. It does not certify canonical readings for all aliases. A cross-head alias can have a different reading; that requires explicit form-specific reading provenance and a separate schema/runtime plan. Romanization conventions are not equated without evidence.

native_runtime_trace.mode: Read-only source trace, not an actual new native provider capture.
native_runtime_trace.finding: right.forms is built only from windows occurring in the supplied full translation; final output is sliced from that translation. Therefore ابن cannot appear from this link when only قهوة occurs. A matching بن/ابن elsewhere may expose contaminated sense/reading metadata subject to other context/ambiguity guards. Source-only canonical-head generation would directly expose ابن; it is not approved.

tests.command: python3 -m unittest test_native_form_identity test_swahili_lexical test_native_gloss_articles test_native_gloss_labels
tests.separate_unrun_module: test_arabic_plural_readings import failed because ahocorasick is absent in the selected system Python; no dependency installed, no plural compiler changes.

raw_archive_read_r01.action: Retained timeout receipt; changed r02 to explicit compiled native IDs via primary-key batches, no broad remote joins or bulk restore.
